guide_passage: If nothing speaks, notice its triggers, bodily effects, and what it makes you do or avoid. An apparent protective purpose is a hypothesis: what it is trying to prevent and what it actually prevents are separate questions. A voice, intuition, or presence can offer information without taking the steering wheel. Is its guidance loving, wise, helpful, and freedom-preserving? Those are tests for following advice, not conditions for allowing difficult feelings to be heard.
next:
Two patterns often do have a protective function. 
Proactive protection
 stays on duty most of the time: the skeptic, intellectualizer, inner critic, or voice watching for weakness and self-indulgence. It may have spent years preventing humiliation, deception, overwhelm, or another abandonment. It has probably watched you begin other healing methods with great enthusiasm and then disappear. It may be tired, but it is experienced and competent.
length: three to five sentences, 60 to 110 words
brief:
- the last paragraph of "Start With Whatever Showed Up" before its first h3.
- what it says, in meaning: if nothing speaks, notice what sets the reaction off, what it does in your body, and what it makes you do or avoid. What it seems to be protecting you from is a guess: what it's trying to prevent and what it actually prevents are two separate questions. A voice, a hunch or a presence can tell you something without taking over. Whether its advice is loving, wise, helpful and leaves you free is how you decide whether to follow it. It isn't a test a hard feeling has to pass before you'll hear it out.
- The article already has, in You Don't Need an Inner Monologue: "Maybe what's actually requiring your attention now is a knot in your stomach." Don't repeat it. Don't use a steering wheel or driving picture (the article's My Journey already has "handing them the steering wheel"), and don't use "gets to" or "get to" for the voice.
- Every sentence has to work for a reader who doesn't remember anything sections back; core terms (your little one, the Nurturer, the Protector, the Guide, the inherited critic voice, borrowed adulthood, pl/ork) are fine.
